minigame_gate.boostability: A boost may be used to take and plant a seed tier. The qualifying boosted Farming level must remain present for both retrieval and planting; after planting, watering and harvesting do not require the boost. Do not infer a boost, its duration, or eligibility from a plan.

requirements.removed_historical_gate: Hosidius favour is not a current access requirement. The level-34 access state followed the removal of Kourend favour in 2024.
required_tools: seed dibber, unless the Farming portion of Barbarian Training has been completed for bare-handed planting
one or more watering cans with usable water doses, or an observed Gricoller's can with usable water doses

location_and_transport: The activity is south-east of Hosidius in Great Kourend. It is an instanced, solo-only activity; entering does not establish a successful session or output.
The Grouping interface minigame teleport can target Tithe Farm only after the player has entered Tithe Farm at least once; first-entry history remains an observed account flag.
Lovakengj Minecart Network to Hosidius South places the player directly south of the activity, subject to its independent network access and destination unlock state.

Fairy ring AKR to Hosidius Vinery, a Hosidius teleport or a POH exit in Hosidius, Xeric's Glade, Kharedst's memoirs or Book of the dead Hosidius reminisce, Skills necklace to Woodcutting Guild, and Kourend Castle Teleport are separate travel alternatives with their own observed ownership, charge, quest, spellbook, and transport requirements.

facts: Search the seed table and select one eligible seed type; the game plays identically for the three types, while their Farming XP differs.
Only one seed type may be taken into a session, with up to 10,000 local seeds available.
Entering supplies Gricoller's fertiliser. Choosing, retaining, using, or discarding it is player-observed.
Plant a local seed in an empty Tithe patch. Planting awards no Farming XP.
A crop takes three minutes to fully grow under normal growth, with a watering requirement before minutes one, two, and three: three waterings total.
If the needed watering is missed before a stage, the crop wilts and dies. A dead crop creates no fruit and must be cleared/replaced before that patch can be replanted.
Applying the supplied Gricoller's fertiliser doubles growth speed. It does not eliminate water-stage requirements or guarantee a successful harvest.
A fully grown crop can be harvested for exactly one matching fruit and the seed-tier harvest XP; fully grown Tithe crops no longer decay.

Harvest count, crop survival, precise Farming XP, Farmer's-outfit wear state, and any pet result must be reported. No model may derive them from elapsed time, a planting pattern, or a selected seed tier.
Deposit harvested fruit into any farm sack. A sack holds at most 100 fruit; if an attempted deposit would exceed its capacity, only enough fruit is deposited to fill it and the sack then empties.

The first 74 fruit in a sack receive the base deposit XP. Fruit 75 through 100 receive double deposit XP, the 75th fruit also gives a fixed seed-tier XP bonus, and the 100th fruit gives two additional Tithe Farm points.

Leaving through the farm door resets the local game/score and removes remaining local seeds and collected fruit, while already-earned points and XP remain. Logging out retains local score, seeds, and collected fruit but removes every planted crop.

point_and_xp_rules.point_formula: One Tithe Farm point for every three deposited fruit, plus two additional points when the 100th fruit is added to a sack.
point_and_xp_rules.boundary: These formulas only calculate from player-observed tier, fruit count, sack position, and outfit-wear state. They do not establish that fruit was deposited or that the reported session completed. Fruit deposited after the observed 16,000-point balance cap still awards its associated Farming XP but awards no further points.

completion_or_reward_events.deterministic_formula: apply the point formula and exact sack-position XP only from an observed selected seed tier, deposited-fruit quantity, and start/end sack state
completion_or_reward_events.state_rule: record fruit, point delta, Farming XP, and post-deposit balance only when reported or imported from a trusted account observation

completion_or_reward_events.deterministic_formula: subtract the listed Tithe Farm point cost and create the specific purchased reward only after both the purchase and pre/post balance are observed
completion_or_reward_events.state_rule: a deterministic shop price is not evidence that the account bought, owns, or can currently use the reward

completion_or_reward_events.event: Herb box or Seed pack opening

completion_or_reward_events.state_rule: record exact observed contents; do not create herbs, seeds, or white lily seeds from the container purchase alone

completion_or_reward_events.deterministic_formula: death removes that crop's possible fruit; logout clears planted crops; exit clears local seeds and fruit while retaining previously earned points and XP

failure_and_death.failure: A crop that misses a required watering stage wilts and dies, produces no fruit, and must be cleared/replaced to reuse that patch. A fully grown crop does not decay under the current rules.
failure_and_death.player_combat_and_death: Tithe Farm has no ordinary combat or reclaim loop. An exceptional player death is outside its normal mechanics and must be recorded separately if reported.
failure_and_death.recovery: The player may plant another local seed in an available patch when they still meet the seed-tier gate and have the relevant local/session supplies. This package does not infer that any seed, tool, water, or local crop is available after a failure.
failure_and_death.persistent_state: Observed Tithe Farm points, purchased permanent unlocks, purchased items, and credited XP persist. Current crops, remaining session seeds, collected but undeployed fruit, fertiliser use, water doses, and sack progress have the stated exit/logout boundaries and remain observed state.

repeatability.activity: repeatable indefinitely after satisfying current entry requirements
repeatability.round_entry: no stated GP fee, daily lockout, quest key, or consumed ticket
repeatability.daily_or_weekly_limit: none stated by current activity documentation

currencies.spend_behavior: Each successfully harvested crop can yield one matching fruit. Fruit is deposited into sacks to trigger deterministic point/XP accounting, but count, tier, sack position, and survival are all observed. It is local session state and is removed on farm exit.

Points derive exactly from observed deposited fruit: one per three fruit plus two on each 100th sack fruit. They buy fixed shop items and unlocks, persist after session exit, and have a current 16,000 point balance cap.
currencies.acquisition_boundary: The formula is deterministic, not the account result. Do not create a point balance from a planned number of plants, elapsed time, or an assumed successful route.

currencies.spend_behavior: One Tithe Farm point buys a bundle of 20 blessings. Their use is separately gated by Bologa's one-time 50 Prayer, 75,000-coin, Zamorak-affiliated-item condition and converts a blessing into one permitted Zamorak grape pick; purchases, gate completion, and resulting grapes remain observed.

dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: Entry requires an observed eligible level; any boost must cover seed withdrawal and planting.

Permanent 200-point alternative to carrying multiple ordinary watering cans; it does not bypass water use or crop timing.
A 50-point permanent Farming-patch convenience effect, subject to the stated existing-weed and Managing Miscellania exclusions.

dependencies_and_bypasses.target: Farming contracts and external patch loops
dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: Tithe Farm shop seed packs, grape seeds, compost items, Auto-weed, storage, watering capacity, and XP clothing can interact with external Farming systems, but this package does not model their outputs or declare a preferred source.

logout_or_idle_constraints: During normal growth, each planted crop needs a watering action before each of three growth stages. A missed stage can kill that crop.
A fully grown crop no longer decays, so the post-growth harvest/deposit portion can be deferred without crop loss; this does not create passive points or XP.

Logging out preserves local session score, selected remaining seeds, and collected fruit but clears planted crops. Leaving by the farm door resets local score and removes local seeds and collected fruit while keeping already earned points and XP.
afk_and_attention.source_boundary: Tithe Farm is not modeled as AFK or passive progression. Guide-reported layouts, route durations, run energy, and hourly rates depend on execution and are strategy candidates rather than account outcomes.

community_strategy_observations.claim: The Wiki community guide presents a basic five-by-twenty pattern, with smaller sets suggested while learning; it advises aiming for 100-fruit deposits for the two-point sack bonus.
The community guide and current videos describe 25x4 and combo patterns as more execution-sensitive alternatives, often using manual watering, movement optimizations, and optional tile markers.

The fertiliser approach is presented as a lower-plant-count, more forgiving pattern that trades route characteristics for shorter growth intervals; a particular plant count, rate, or attention burden is player-specific.

BRUHsailer suggests temporary boosts for Bologano and a 25x4-style method in parts of its Ironman guide. That is route advice, not evidence that this account has the boost, food, run energy, capability, or desired target.
Community discussion treats common 20- to 25-plant patterns as subjective trade-offs between forgiveness and intensity, rather than a universal stop target or a dependable output rate.

state_boundaries: Do not infer current Farming level, temporary boost, membership, travel availability, first-entry history, tools, water doses, Gricoller's can, fertiliser use, run energy, outfit wear, seed tier, or account readiness.

Do not infer a planted crop, its watering-stage progress, its survival, maturity, harvest, exact fruit, sack position, deposit, XP, point balance, shop purchase, container result, grape, blessing use, or collection-log entry from elapsed time, a suggested layout, or a strategy target.

Track crop status and session state only from explicit observations. A timer/plugin display may assist a player but does not establish that a watering action occurred or that the client/session remained active.

Only apply deterministic arithmetic after its inputs are observed: selected seed tier, crop/fruit count, exact fruit deposited, sack position, full-outfit wear state where relevant, observed point balance, and an observed confirmed shop transaction.

Separate persistent point/shop/XP state from session-local seeds, fruit, crops, fertiliser choice, water, and sacks. Apply the documented logout and exit consequences only when the corresponding event is explicitly reported.
